subject.title: Feature: enrich usage/status JSON with agent, cron, and channel labels

question: Which attribution fields should OpenClaw commit to on official usage/status JSON, especially cron identity and channel target privacy?
rationale: This expands a public machine-readable API surface and includes privacy-sensitive target classification choices that source inspection cannot settle safely.

options.title: Add minimal privacy-safe core fields
options.body: Add optional cronJobId/cronJobName/sessionKind/channelTargetKind fields without raw target ids by default, and document them as the stable dashboard contract.

options.title: Split cron first
options.body: Handle cron job id/name attribution as a narrower status/usage addition and defer channel target classification until privacy semantics are designed.

options.title: Keep adapters external for now
options.body: Leave dashboards to join session, cron, and channel metadata locally until maintainers want to grow the official telemetry schema.

recommendation.title: Add minimal privacy-safe core fields
recommendation.body: Add optional cronJobId/cronJobName/sessionKind/channelTargetKind fields without raw target ids by default, and document them as the stable dashboard contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest cross-surface history in usage, status, session metadata, and cron-adjacent behavior.
